//: Runtime-transform project for the bun typia preload (packages/validation/src/bun/preload.ts). The preload routes every loaded file to its own nearest project, searching upward for `tsconfig.lib.json` for imported production source. Without this file the nearest match is packages/lmao/tsconfig.lib.json, whose directory is the package root — so @ttsc/unplugin walks and hashes the package's Rust crates and generated distribution in addition to the TypeScript source. That walk is paid by every package that imports lmao source, not just by lmao. Rooting the project at src/ keeps the walk to the sources actually being transformed.
